title: The Spanish Love Deception
author: Elena Armas
summary: A woman needs a date for her sister's wedding in Spain and, after a boast that backfires, asks the colleague she can't stand to pose as her boyfriend. A week with her family and his quiet attention changes how she sees him.
readIf: you want a slow-thawing fake-dating story with a stern hero and a big, noisy family.
skipIf: you dislike a long stretch of will-they-won't-they before anything resolves.

pairings.reason: Another fake-relationship romance with a reserved, secretly devoted hero and a lot of humour.
Both put a city woman into an unfamiliar setting alongside a gruff, protective man.
A larger-scale fake-friendship-to-romance with more wit and more at stake publicly.
